description: List disruptions SL has announced: track work, closed entrances, broken lifts and replacement buses, with the lines affected and until when. Use it to check a line or the stops of a trip before travelling, e.g. lifts for a wheelchair. For live delays and cancelled departures, use get_departures instead. The text is in Swedish, so translate it if needed, and is cut at 800 characters. Results are cached for 1 minute, as SL asks. Leave both filters out to list everything.

lines.description: Only these line numbers, e.g. ['13', '14'], or metro colours, e.g. ['grön linje']

name: get_disruptions
title: Get disruptions
